title: An operability window with a measured confidence: a buoy's sea, a vessel's answer, a mooring and the hours left
description: NOAA NDBC station 41010 -- 45 days of ten-minute sea state and 2080 measured wave spectra, 20 NM east of Cape Canaveral in 30 m of water -- read, fitted, forecast with a horizon and scored against itself by halves; a 20 m beam, 6 m draught section whose added mass, damping and excitation come from the two-dimensional free-surface problem solved on a grid; the motions that follow at a crane pedestal and at the bow; the quasi-static catenary of an eight-line mooring and what two lost lines do to the rest; five instrument records with a slam, a mooring step and two failed sensors injected, all five diagnosed correctly; and the product, an operability window quoted with the fraction of hours the forecast's verdict was measured to match the observation's -- 96 % at one hour and 76 % at twenty-four.
methods: 2-D free-surface potential flow (finite volume, complex-frequency sponge)
residual diagnosis with a redundant sensor pair
operability criteria with a measured decision confidence

metrics.name: jonswap_fit_error
metrics.how: median RMS of log S(f) over the energetic bands, for a JONSWAP fitted to each of 120 measured spectra; the Pierson-Moskowitz shape gives 0.428 on the same spectra

metrics.name: fitted_gamma
metrics.how: median peak enhancement of the fitted spectra, against the 3.3 the JONSWAP average is quoted with and the 1.0 of Pierson-Moskowitz

metrics.name: hs_from_spectrum_against_wvht
metrics.how: 4 sqrt(m0) over NDBC's 46 published bands against the buoy's own WVHT: the bands the file carries are 2.6 % short of the number NDBC reports

metrics.name: hs_skill_at_12h
metrics.how: 1 - MSE(model)/MSE(persistence) for Hs on 254 analyses on the second half of the record, coefficients fitted on the first half: RMSE 0.527 m against 0.532 m

metrics.name: tp_skill_at_12h
metrics.how: the same score for the period: RMSE 1.41 s against 1.44 s; with the other wind-sea closure (relaxing toward a fully developed sea) it is 0.164

metrics.name: heave_rao_long_wave
metrics.how: the solved section at an 80 s period: a body small against the wavelength has to move with the water

metrics.name: roll_rao_long_wave
metrics.how: roll per radian of wave slope at 80 s, from the same solve

metrics.name: roll_resonance_solved
metrics.how: the peak of the solved roll response; the hydrostatic period with k_xx = 0.35 B is 11.47 s, and the solve measures A44 = 0.48 I44, which is the difference

metrics.name: mooring_static_tension
metrics.how: the quasi-static catenary at rest: 404 kN, 6.9 % of the 5.83 MN breaking load of the 76 mm chain

metrics.name: mooring_tension_two_lines_lost
metrics.how: at the same 400 kN environmental load the intact spread sits 5.15 m off with 512 kN on the worst line, and with two lines gone it sits 8.86 m off with 598 kN: 10.3 % of breaking

metrics.name: mooring_stiffness
metrics.how: the slope of the worst tension against the offset at rest, where the line still lies on the seabed

metrics.name: decision_skill_at_1h
metrics.how: the fraction of 254 analyses whose operability verdict from the forecast matched the verdict from what the buoy then measured, at a one-hour lead

metrics.name: decision_skill_at_24h
metrics.how: the same fraction at a 24 h lead: the confidence a window is quoted with falls from 96 % to 76 % across the day

metrics.name: events_diagnosed_correctly
metrics.how: five instrument records -- quiet, slam, mooring step, spiking accelerometer, stuck accelerometer -- and the kind of event each was called

checks.name: the_spectrum_integrates_to_its_height
checks.label: 4 sqrt(m0) returns the Hs the spectrum was built with to 0.03 % at four sea states

checks.name: long_wave_response_is_unity
checks.label: heave 1.0009 and roll 1.062 at an 80 s period, where a small body must move with the water

checks.name: the_damping_is_not_negative
checks.label: heave damping positive at every period solved, and both added mass and damping fall away at the short-wave end

checks.name: the_grid_does_not_move_the_answer
checks.label: 40 nodes per wavelength and a four-wavelength sponge change the heave response by under 2 %; the added mass is the quantity sensitive to the sponge, which is why it is three wavelengths long

checks.name: the_roll_resonance_matches_its_own_inertia
checks.label: the resonance lands where C44/(I44 + A44) says with the A44 the solve measured, and it is later than the hydrostatic period, as added inertia must make it

checks.name: losing_lines_raises_the_load
checks.label: at a constant environmental load the six remaining lines carry 598 kN against 512 kN for eight

checks.name: a_quiet_sea_stays_quiet
checks.label: the quiet record raises no event at a four-sigma threshold with a share rule, so the detector does not fire on its own noise

checks.name: the_five_scenarios_are_diagnosed_for_what_they_are
checks.label: slam called a slam, a tension step called the mooring, a spike and a stuck channel called instruments, and the quiet record called nothing

references.title: NOAA National Data Buoy Center, station 41010 (Canaveral) standard meteorological, spectral density and wave summary files
references.note: US Government work, no account; the 45-day slice is written by build_dataset.py as a 173 kB npz with the URL and the window in it

references.title: Hasselmann et al. (1973), Measurements of wind-wave growth and swell decay during the Joint North Sea Wave Project (JONSWAP)
references.note: the spectral shape with the peak enhancement the fit here measures at gamma = 1.8 on average

references.title: Pierson & Moskowitz (1964), A proposed spectral form for fully developed wind seas
references.note: alpha = 0.0081 and omega_p = 0.877 g/U, which give Hs = 0.21 U^2/g and Tp = 7.16 U/g and are checked in the tests against those relations

references.title: Biran & Lopez-Pulido, Ship Hydrostatics and Stability, 2nd ed. (2014)
references.note: GM, the waterplane second moment and the roll period the solved resonance is compared with; the 0.35 B gyration estimate is the one pinneapple_simulation.naval.hydrostatics already uses
